name: oxide-dice
description: Roll dice and greet people. A sample extension for testing Oxide.
long_description: A dependency-free Node.js MCP server packed as a desktop extension. Its settings exercise every kind Oxide supports: text, a number with a range, a switch, and a sensitive token kept in the system keychain.

tools.name: roll_dice
tools.description: Roll dice and add them up

tools.description: Show which settings the server received

lucky_number.description: Mentioned when a die shows it.

api_token.description: Any text: it shows that sensitive settings reach the server from the keychain (settings_check reports only its length).
